description: Two peak meters with VU-style dials and mechanical needle movement, passing every sample straight through while they watch

inputs.text: The signal that side meters, passed to the output beside it unchanged

outputs.text: An exact copy of the input for that side, with the same channel count and no gain, filtering or delay

notes: the two sides are independent and nothing is normalled between them, so patching the left alone leaves the right meter at rest and its output empty
the dial runs from -20 VU to +3 VU, where 0 VU is about 7.08V peak and +3 VU is the 10V peak that is full scale in Rack, so the red half of the dial is the last 3dB of headroom
the needle rises with a 15ms time constant and falls with a 450ms one, which reveals a transient without vibrating too fast to read
with a polyphonic cable the dial follows the loudest channel present, so one hot voice cannot hide inside a chord
the detector reads absolute magnitude, so a slow control voltage moves the needle the same way whether it goes positive or negative
menu: Screen brightness — sets how brightly the dials are lit, which changes the artwork alone and not the needles or the signal
